Rear-Tipping Semi-Trailer

Scroll to Explore

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Built for Construction Haulage · T700C Body · Heavy-Duty Cylinder · FUWA 13 t Axles

The EHJ9400ZHX rear-tipping semi-trailer combines an integrated T700C high-strength steel body, reinforced main beams and a heavy-duty hydraulic lifting system for coal, ore, aggregates and construction spoil.

FUWA 13 t axles and 12R22.5 radial tires are paired with air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers) and KOMEE ABS. A 50° rear-tipping angle supports thorough discharge. The Xiangqi brand is listed in China's vehicle type-approval catalog; the company undertakes national key equipment projects and provides factory-direct sales and after-sales support across 30+ provincial regions.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Structural Features · Built for Heavy Construction Loads

01 CARGO BOX

T700C High-Strength Steel Body

Formed T700C high-strength steel with a 10 mm floor and 6 mm sides provides bending, torsion and impact resistance for sustained heavy-load operation.

02 HYDRAULIC

Heavy-Duty Hydraulic Lift

A large-bore cylinder and PTO-driven gear pump enable a rear-tipping angle of 50° for thorough discharge, with heat resistance and durability in the hydraulic system.

03 MAIN BEAM

Reinforced Main Beams

T700C steel, tapered beam welding and diagonal bracing work with reinforced crossmembers and side beams for stable load support.

04 SUSPENSION

Leaf Springs + FUWA Axles

10×13 leaf springs and FUWA 13 t axles provide roll resistance in corners and absorb vibration on construction routes.

05 SAFETY

Dual Braking + ABS

Air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers), KOMEE ABS and a rear support safety lock provide controlled braking on loaded descents and stability while discharging.
